title: AI Is Turning Retail Traders Into DIY Hedge Funds
description: The rollout of powerful new tools is inspiring a generation of day traders who are trying to crack Wall Street’s secret code and create automated money machines. Bloomberg's Zijia Song explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
